pairs: A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
Shout joyfully to God with a voice of exultation.
a great King over all the earth.
He has subjected the peoples to us
and subdued the nations under our feet.
He has chosen us for his inheritance:
the splendor of Jacob, whom he has loved.
and the Lord with the voice of the trumpet.
For God is the King of all the earth.
God will reign over the peoples.
Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.
God sits upon his holy throne.
Principes populorum congregati sunt cum Deo Abraham,
The leaders of the peoples have been gathered together by the God of Abraham.
quoniam dii fortes terræ vehementer elevati sunt.
For the strong gods of the earth have been exceedingly exalted.
